basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old gaming enthusiast who recently discovered the world of Reddit. I love exploring different games and often find myself diving deep into game-related subreddits. I'm currently a college student studying computer science, and I spend my free time gaming or reading about my favorite historical events, particularly the Titanic. I live in a small town in the Midwest, USA, and my online hours are usually late evenings after classes and assignments. I'm single and enjoy connecting with others who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of computer games and enjoy learning about different game mechanics and strategies. Most of my knowledge comes from years of playing and experimenting with various genres. My interest in history, especially events like the Titanic, comes from self-directed research and reading.
